feed.title: Breach Tracker: new and updated records

entry.title: Adventure Inc.: unknown (press report)
entry.summary: Adventure Inc. reported unauthorized access to Skyticket administrative functionality from October 2 to October 4, 2026, affecting approximately 14.64 million customer records. Disclosed 2026-10-09. 14,640,000 records. Source: https://beyondmachines.net/event_details/adventure-inc-data-breach-affects-approximately-14-64-million-skyticket-customer-records-j-o-l-x-1/gD2P6Ple2L

entry.title: Coupang, Inc.: insider (org confirmed)
entry.summary: Coupang disclosed that a former employee may have obtained personal data associated with up to 33 million customer accounts. Disclosed 2025-12-16. Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1834584/000183458425000196/cpng-20251215.htm

entry.title: Zoomcar Holdings, Inc.: unknown (org confirmed)
entry.summary: Zoomcar Holdings identified unauthorized access to a dataset containing personal information associated with approximately 8.4 million users. Disclosed 2025-06-13. 8,400,000 records. Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1854275/000121390025054319/ea0245724-8k_zoomcar.htm

entry.title: loanDepot: unknown (org confirmed)
entry.summary: loanDepot reported that a cybersecurity incident affected sensitive personal information of up to approximately 16.9 million individuals. Disclosed 2024-02-27. 16,900,000 records. Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1831631/000183163124000020/ldi-20240104.htm

entry.title: VF Corporation: unknown (org confirmed)
entry.summary: VF Corporation reported that a cyber incident disrupted operations and resulted in the theft of personal data belonging to approximately 35.5 million consumers. Disclosed 2023-12-18. 35,500,000 records. Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/103379/000119312524010243/d641969d8ka.htm

entry.title: Waco Independent School District: exploit public facing app (press report)
entry.summary: Waco Independent School District employee and applicant information was exposed in a Frontline Education security incident after attackers exploited a vulnerability in software used by the provider. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://beyondmachines.net/event_details/waco-isd-employee-data-exposed-in-frontline-education-security-incident-n-e-j-k-u/gD2P6Ple2L

entry.title: Trump Mobile: unknown (press report)
entry.summary: A report said hackers stole personal data belonging to 3,615 Trump Mobile customers; the attack method was not stated. Disclosed 2026-10-09. 3,615 records. Source: https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/10/trump-mobile-doesnt-seem-to-have-fcc-authorization-for-phone-service-senator-says/

entry.title: Taiwan Ministry of the Interior: unknown (actor claimed)
entry.summary: pkevin claimed possession of a Taiwan Ministry of the Interior citizen registry database containing 23.5 million records. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://infosec.exchange/@darkwebsonar/117411052546657826

entry.title: SOCOCO: unknown (actor claimed)
entry.summary: UmBra claimed on its leak site that it exfiltrated data from SOCOCO, but the claim has not been independently verified. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://www.yazoul.net/intel/claim/2026-10-09-sococo-ransomware-claim-by-umbra-october-2026

entry.title: Neogen: unknown (actor claimed)
entry.summary: ShinyHunters published data it claimed came from Neogen, including 435,963 unique email addresses, after an extortion demand went unpaid. Disclosed 2026-10-09. 435,963 records. Source: https://www.yazoul.net/breaches/breach/neogen-breach-436k-email-addresses-leaked-by-shinyhunters-2026

entry.title: Moscow Department of Health: unknown (press report)
entry.summary: The Belarusian Cyber Partisans claimed a 2023 intrusion into the Moscow Department of Health, and researchers reported that attackers accessed sensitive medical information without disrupting operations. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://therecord.media/belarusian-cyber-partisans-claim-2023-russia-healthcare-hack

entry.title: Liberty X: unknown (actor claimed)
entry.summary: BYOD claimed to possess Liberty X data in an unverified leak-site post, but no breach or data exfiltration was independently confirmed. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://www.yazoul.net/intel/claim/2026-10-08-liberty-x-ransomware-claim-by-byod-oct-2026

entry.title: iRhythm: vishing or social engineering (org confirmed)
entry.summary: iRhythm reported that attackers used social engineering to access third-party-hosted business applications and exfiltrate personal and medical information. Disclosed 2026-10-09. 360,000 records. Source: https://therecord.media/irhythm-data-breach-reports

entry.title: IDC Frontier: unknown (org confirmed)
entry.summary: IDC Frontier confirmed that a third-party ransomware attack disrupted four zones of IDCF Cloud, affecting 495 companies and local governments. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://japancyberwatch.com/articles/idcf-cloud-unauthorized-access-outage-2026

entry.title: Google: unknown (press report)
entry.summary: Google domains were affected by hijacks of third-party country-code domains that led to unauthorized HTTPS certificates being issued. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://www.securityweek.com/google-domains-impacted-by-recent-cctld-domain-hijacks/

entry.title: Federal Bureau of Investigation: exploit public facing app (press report)
entry.summary: The FBI reported a breach involving a third-party contractor-managed platform, with ShinyHunters claiming it stole FBI data. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/fbi-arrests-another-suspected-shinyhunters-hacker-after-agency-breach/

entry.title: Casper Orthopedic Associates: unknown (press report)
entry.summary: Casper Orthopedic Associates disclosed a cyberattack discovered on May 23, 2026, that may have exposed patient information affecting 56,197 individuals. Disclosed 2026-10-09. 56,197 records. Source: https://beyondmachines.net/event_details/casper-orthopedic-associates-data-breach-affects-more-than-56000-individuals-u-o-b-f-k/gD2P6Ple2L

entry.title: Canadian Mennonite University: unknown (press report)
entry.summary: Canadian Mennonite University reported that an unauthorized party accessed files containing personal and tax information, and that information was stolen. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://beyondmachines.net/event_details/canadian-mennonite-university-data-breach-exposes-personal-and-tax-information-o-j-t-d-o/gD2P6Ple2L

entry.title: Atlantic Digestive Specialists: unknown (press report)
entry.summary: Atlantic Digestive Specialists reported unauthorized access to files containing personal and protected health information after suspicious activity was detected in March 2026. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://beyondmachines.net/event_details/atlantic-digestive-specialists-data-breach-exposes-patient-information-d-n-s-a-i/gD2P6Ple2L

entry.title: ASOS: vishing or social engineering (org confirmed)
entry.summary: ASOS said an attacker impersonated a trusted contact to obtain an employee’s credentials and access information on third-party platforms, exposing personal and account-related information. Disclosed 2026-10-09. Source: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/asos-links-data-breach-to-social-engineering-attack-credential-theft/

entry.title: Coupang: unknown (press report)
entry.summary: Coupang reported a November 2025 data breach affecting more than 33 million customers. Disclosed 2026-10-08. Source: https://databreaches.net/2026/10/08/kr-coupang-files-lawsuits-against-620-billion-won-fine-over-data-leak/
